dd_proposal_facility.label: Proposal facility lines
dd_proposal_facility.grain: one row per proposal facility line

dd_obligor_financials.label: Obligor financials
dd_obligor_financials.grain: one row per proposal and financial year

dd_collateral_guarantee.label: Collateral and guarantees
dd_collateral_guarantee.grain: one row per collateral item or guarantee

dd_portfolio_snapshot.label: Portfolio snapshot and headroom
dd_portfolio_snapshot.grain: one row per limit dimension and key

dd_result.label: Priced results
dd_result.grain: one row per proposal and view (ask, recommended)

proposal_id.description: Deal Desk proposal identifier (DD-nn seeded, DD-1nn added by users).

reporting_quarter.description: As-of quarter of the corporate book the proposal is checked against.

obligor_id.description: Obligor: the book borrower id (CB#####) for an existing borrower, DN### for a new-to-bank name.

existing_flag.description: 1 when the obligor is an existing borrower in the corporate book.

new_to_bank_flag.description: 1 when the obligor is new to the bank.

status.description: Pipeline status: new, in_review, counter_offered, approved or declined.

rm.description: Relationship manager who submitted the proposal.

case_type.description: The test case the proposal represents (e.g. large_exposure, infeasible).

internal_rating.description: Internal rating (global order AAA to C).

external_rating.description: External rating where the obligor has one; empty when unrated.

group_id.description: Connected group (relationship-domain ownership group, CG… for book groups, DG… for new ones).

simah_flag.description: SIMAH bureau flag: clear, watch or adverse.

sme_flag.description: 1 when the obligor is an SME.

gre_flag.description: 1 when the obligor is a government-related entity.

existing_ead_sar_mn.description: Obligor's EAD in the corporate book at the as-of quarter before the deal.

facility_type.description: Facility type: term_loan, revolver, performance_lg, financial_lg or trade_lc.

structure.description: Structure: conventional, murabaha, tawarruq, ijara or musharaka.

amount.description: Requested amount in the deal currency.

amortisation.description: Amortisation profile: equal, bullet or balloon.

balloon_pct.description: Share repaid at maturity when the profile is balloon.

commitment_fee_bps.description: Commitment fee on the undrawn balance.

commission_bps.description: LG/LC commission per year on the unfunded outstanding.

funded_share_pct.description: Funded share of the amount; the rest is unfunded.

cash_margin_pct.description: Cash margin held as collateral, as a share of the amount.

covenant_package.description: Covenant package: none, standard or enhanced.

guarantee_id.description: Guarantee included in the ask, if any.

guarantee_coverage_pct.description: Share of the exposure the guarantee covers.

line_id.description: Facility line: DD-nn-F (proposed funded), DD-nn-U (proposed unfunded), or the book facility id.

line_kind.description: proposed or existing (a book facility of an existing borrower).

facility_id.description: Book facility id (CF######) for existing lines; empty for proposed lines.

funded_flag.description: 1 for a funded line, 0 for an unfunded (LG/LC) line (book facility class for existing lines).

drawn_sar_mn.description: Drawn balance (existing lines at the as-of quarter).

stage.description: IFRS 9 stage of an existing book facility.

item_id.description: Collateral (C…) or guarantee (G…) id within the proposal.

item_type.description: Collateral type (cash, real_estate, plant_equipment, receivables, shares, vehicles) or guarantee type (corporate, personal, government, kafalah, bank).

value.description: Collateral market value in its own currency.

haircut_pct.description: Haircut applied to the collateral value (lgd parameter table).

offered_in_ask_flag.description: 1 when the item is part of the client's ask, 0 when only available.

param_key.description: Path of the value inside the table (dot-separated).

owner.description: Named owner of the table (Treasury, Finance, Risk Models, CFO, Risk).

dimension.description: Limit dimension: sector, rating_bucket, collateral_type or group.

dimension_key.description: The sector, bucket, collateral type or connected group.

share_pct.description: Share of the corporate book's EAD.

limit_pct.description: Concentration limit as a share of the book, where one applies.

limit_sar_mn_cap.description: Absolute limit, where one applies (connected group).

headroom_sar_mn.description: New EAD the dimension can take before its limit.

limit_kind.description: hard or soft (soft limits can be exceeded with escalation).

view.description: ask (the client's terms) or recommended (closest-to-ask structure that clears the hurdle and the limits).

pd_12m.description: 12-month PD from the XGBoost model after the covenant overlay.

capital_y1_sar_mn.description: Year-1 allocated capital (basis max of regulatory and economic, plus operational).

sva_sar_mn.description: Shareholder value added: PV(risk-adjusted profit - hurdle x capital).

breakeven_margin_bps.description: Margin at which lifetime RAROC equals the hurdle (funded deals).

decision.description: approve_as_asked, counter_offer, escalate (only with a soft-limit breach) or decline.

hard_breaches.description: Hard limits breached by this structure, separated by semicolons.

soft_breaches.description: Soft limits breached by this structure, separated by semicolons.

param_version.description: Parameter version the result was priced with.

documents: Credit memos (.docx) stay as files in data/dealdesk/memos, one per proposal (memo_file).
